endMeetingFirst: End the current meeting before testing the connection
invalidWorkspaceId: Workspace ID may only contain letters, digits and hyphens (e.g. llm-xxx)
listenLoopback: “Play their translation” needs an app selected under “Listen to” on the home screen. Otherwise the played translation would be captured again and loop.
sameLanguagePair: Source and target language must differ. Pick the languages again on the home screen.
sessionsStopping: Translation sessions are stopping. Try again in a moment.

sessionKind.auth: The provider rejected the credentials. Check that the API key is correct and the service is enabled.
sessionKind.quota: Out of provider quota, or too many requests. Check your account balance or try again later.
sessionKind.network: Can't reach the translation service. Check your network or proxy settings.
sessionKind.timeout: The translation service didn't respond in time. Try again; for overseas engines, check that your proxy works.
sessionKind.protocol: The translation service refused the request. The language pair or settings may not be supported.
sessionKind.server: The translation service is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
sessionKind.credentials-missing: No credentials are set up for this engine yet. Add them in Settings.
sessionKind.audio-device: An audio device failed. Check your microphone or output device and try again.
sessionKind.unknown: The translation session stopped unexpectedly. Try again.
